tier2.summary:
INCOMPLETE
  ✗ cmd_check and cmd_recall fail CLOSED when the DuckBrain substrate is unreachable (transport error or non-200): both exit non-zero with an explicit error naming the substrate failure, never print 'no stored evidence matched — treat as a new question' or an empty recall on a failed call. Tests cover the fail-closed path for both verbs; bash tests/gate.sh ends GATE PASS.: Code + tests satisfy the fail-closed requirement, but the gate does NOT end GATE PASS. CODE: auger.py:1076 adds `class SubstrateError(SystemExit)`; auger.py:1087-1115 `recall()` raises SubstrateError for st==0 (the _req transport contract, auger.py:409-410) and every non-200, while a real 200 with no items still returns [] (404 only tolerated via the documented missing_ok carve-out used by recall_many, auger.py:1199-1214). cmd_check (auger.py:4124-4141) catches it, prints 'substrate unavailable — cannot check: {exc}' plus a fail-closed note and `return 1`; the 'no stored evidence matched — treat as a new question' line at auger.py:4139 is reachable only when recall returned [] (rc 0). cmd_recall (auger.py:4702-4719) likewise prints 'substrate unavailable — cannot recall: {exc}' and `return 1`, printing nothing on a genuine empty 200. main() returns a.fn(a) and sys.exit(main()) (auger.py:5108-5112), so rc 1 is a non-zero exit. cmd_ask (auger.py:3423-3431) and gate_question (auger.py:1729-1730) also map the raise onto their fail-closed channels. TESTS: fresh run `python3 -m pytest tests/test_auger.py -k "aug075 or substrate or fails_closed or dead_store or missing_namespace or missing_sibling" -q` -> exit 0, '6 passed, 185 deselected in 3.70s'; the new cases at tests/test_auger.py:1452-1585 cover both verbs (test_check_fails_closed_when_the_substrate_is_dead asserts rc==1, 'substrate' in out, and 'treat as a new question' NOT in out; test_recall_verb_fails_closed_when_the_store_is_unreachable asserts rc==1 and that a genuine empty keeps rc 0/silent), all mocked at the db() boundary. GATE: fresh `bash tests/gate.sh` -> syntax OK, lint 'All checks passed!', pytest '1 failed, 190 passed in 969.56s (0:16:09)' and NO 'GATE PASS' line (exit non-zero). The single failure is tests/test_auger.py::test_confidence_sentinel_stays_in_the_store_and_never_renders (assert '-1' not in dump_out, tests/test_auger.py:6087) — a pre-existing, unrelated flake: the identical assertion exists unchanged at line 5944 of HEAD~1, the dump header embeds datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() (auger.py:4559), and the test passes in isolation ('1 passed in 7.03s'). It is untouched by this commit (the diff only adds AUG-075 tests and updates recall stub signatures). Nonetheless the criterion's literal requirement — 'bash tests/gate.sh ends GATE PASS' — is not met on this run.
The fail-closed code and its tests for cmd_check/cmd_recall are correct and pass, but the required gate run ended '1 failed, 190 passed' with no GATE PASS (a pre-existing, unrelated timestamp/namespace-substring flake in test_confidence_sentinel_stays_in_the_store_and_never_renders), so the criterion is not fully satisfied.
